primaryWitnesses.text: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

wikipediaRead.title: Labweh
wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 現行redirect先は現代村Labweh。History節は“it has been suggested”としてLebo-hamathとの関連説を紹介するが、Numbers34:8等の境界語句に触れない。関連説のみ記録。
wikipediaRead.articleTextEvidence: turn2068view4 lines 59, 119–145; canonical title Labweh, redirect from Lebo-hamath; line 145 states only a suggested historical identification.
wikipediaRead.reuseBasisJa: 同一既存ID place:lebo-hamath_723 の先行稿から再利用。今回の列王記用本文・初出は別途固定WEBで再構築。

sourceReuse.reasonJa: 同一IDの既存稿のみを参考にし、本文・初出・常時欄をKingsの固定WEBへ再構成。
